items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Me, and Joe Comfort, and James Nelson, Hawk, Lorenzo, myself on drums and Doris Lathy on guitar.

ctx.x: So December 8th is when America declares war on Japan and Germany.
Whenever that time was. You know, the point is this, whenever war was, I was working with Lorenzo Flennoy at that time. You ever heard of Joe Comfort?
